package_scope: Figure/table and summary evidence only; NOT the complete raw research archive.
raw_archive_status: Retained separately by the author; not distributed here.
archive_reference_convention: research_archive/... and manuscript_source/... are provenance labels, not required local paths.

evidence_review.purpose: Claim-to-evidence audit for the real manuscript rewrite around a joint capacity-release lower bound and the cost of exact local search.

review_scope.actions: Read frozen summaries, completed gates, independent audits, protocols and necessary formula/source implementations; save a new review only.
review_scope.important_limit: This review checks existing evidence and interpretations; it does not rerun raw audits or replace a line-by-line review of the forthcoming new manuscript.

evidence_review.recommended_primary_claim: An identity-preserving two-receipt capacity-release relaxation, evaluated selectively within exact/anytime search, reduces the work and wall time needed to prove the local H2 optimum on the prespecified synthetic confirmation cohort. A separately proved J adapter establishes implementable single-epoch online integration, with no incremental native service benefit in the tested cohort.
recommended_experimental_hierarchy: Primary mechanism attribution: HZ_AWA_RADIUS_PAIR_GATED versus HZ_AWA_RADIUS inside the identical complete HZ engine.
Secondary complete-policy comparison: HZ_AWA_RADIUS_PAIR_GATED versus ANA_RADIUS.
Deployment reference: frozen RADIUS_PAIR_AWA_GATED; its additional implementation-speed difference is not all attributable to the bound.
Native online integration and memory are separate evidence layers, retaining null effects and costs.
V448 exploratory and V449 method-selection results must not be relabelled as independent confirmation of the V450 selected method.

assumptions: Local model: one fixed receiver/hub, two indivisible atomic incoming batches with a received before b; 0<wa<wb<=Q and wa+wb>Q.
Initial old load does not exceed Q; old parcels have positive weights; no splitting, temporary unloading/storage or alternative pickup order is permitted by this model.
Receiving a before b plus wa+wb>Q forces delivery of a before receipt of b. Capacity alone does not prove that a-first pickup is optimal in an unrestricted problem.

Local FIFO earliest-arrival network permits waiting, with load-independent travel and nonnegative service/transfer times; experimental service and travel ticks are positive. Supplier ETA is A and it remains available at the hub after the first handoff.

Goal is second handoff completion H2. Local terminal states can retain old cargo and do not require delivery of b: H2 is not full-route completion, customer-flow J, truck waiting, or global dispatch cost.
All local experimental clocks are integer ticks. Services differ by parcel, and tau_a and tau_b may differ. Do not impose the online common-service special case on the local model.
Earlier-arrival dominance is justified only for the local FIFO model. The online non-FIFO predictor instead retains exact full prefix identity.
construct: At phase zero, qa=(L+wa-Q)+ and qb=(L+wb-Q)+. Compute weighted individual-via return thresholds Rqa/Rqb; R0 is direct hub arrival, not zero.
B=max(A,Rqa)+tau_a; H_R=max(F_a(B),max(A,Rqb))+tau_b. F_a includes serving a and returning to the hub.

alpha_o=v_o+tau_a, E1(x)={o:alpha_o<=x}. Residual quota is (qb-weight(E1(x)))+. The Gamma threshold uses ONLY old identities outside E1; Gamma visits both a and that old parcel in either order and includes both services.
Minimize max(F_a(x), residual Gamma threshold)+tau_b over at most |O|+1 events {B} union {alpha_o>=B}, and take max with H_R.
FIFO makes the relaxed expression nondecreasing inside intervals with fixed E1. This gives an exact finite-event minimum of the optimistic coverage relaxation, not an exact feasible route schedule.
RADIUS replacement removes the phase-zero exact quota subset-path DP. It does not remove the 2^m weight table, combinatorial search, or all exponential memory/work.
Full joint radius bound is at least its own radius baseline by construction. It is not proved to dominate the older exact ROUTE baseline in all states.
cutoff_and_certificate: xcap=max(B,Rqb+tau_a) makes E1 cover qb. Urel=F_a(xcap)+tau_b upper-bounds the raw relaxation minimum; it is NOT a feasible-route incumbent or admissible lower bound.
Given H_R<U, Urel<U safely skips a prune-only check. Do not replace strict '<' by '<=' under the local >=U rejection rule.
Local integer cutoff deadline is U-tau_b-1. The continuous online adapter instead derives a J-specific EPS inequality; do not copy the integer subtraction.
Pathmax propagates unweighted admissible lower bounds. AWA weighted priority and Urel must never be used for pruning certificates.

Weighted search is exact only when its unweighted frontier certificate closes, or upon complete search. A first feasible/generated goal or an arbitrary one-second interruption does not automatically carry a w=2 optimality guarantee.

claims.claim: A concrete joint two-receipt relaxation is developed and proved admissible under the stated local model.
claims.qualification: Conventional ingredients include quota thresholds, resource identity, temporal profiles, metric closures, Pathmax and published search policies. Claim the specific construction, not invention of those ingredients or a universal first-publication result.

claims.claim: The frozen low-cost implementation and complete policy adapters passed finite correctness checks.
claims.qualification: Existing completed gates are stronger evidence than stale preparation notes saying 'not run'. Finite gates support implementation correctness; the theorem supplies the general admissibility argument. Do not inflate micro coverage to all m<=12 timed prefixes.

claims.claim: V450 confirmation uses 64 unseen mothers and 256 related scenarios.
claims.qualification: Each mother has four matched variants. Technical repetitions and variants are not independent draws. This is a local 6-12-old-parcel study, not large-scale citywide fleet validation.

claims.claim: The same-engine added check lowers local optimality-proof cost.
claims.qualification: Ratios are ratios of sums of scenario medians, not means of per-case speedups, per-run speed guarantees, or population effects. Both numerator and denominator use exactly the same all-three-repetitions-proved-within-1s subset.

claims.claim: The same-engine benefit is observed in every prespecified old-parcel size stratum.
claims.qualification: Descriptive stratum results only; do not extrapolate this trend beyond m=12, claim statistical significance, or call small m proof timing noise-free.

claims.claim: The same-engine candidate also has lower proof cost than the complete ANA policy adapter.
claims.qualification: This crosses search policies and supports a system-level comparison on the shared local model. It is not the pure causal bound ablation.

claims.claim: Earlier approximate solutions are not uniformly improved by the check.
claims.qualification: Targets are H2*+fraction*(H2*-t0), i.e. relative to optimal remaining duration, not directly fraction*H2*. Targets use an external optimum post hoc and are never passed to the solver. No all-three initial solution already meets the reported 0/5/10% target on this cohort.

claims.claim: Literal-deadline quality and proof coverage are distinct.
claims.qualification: W/T/L compares medians of three timely objective values; it is not repeat-wise domination. The retained case v450_fair_main_s94512007_m12_tight_free reaches its oracle H2=244 under every method within 1s but the HZ baseline and ANA lack all-three timely proofs. Never delete it or call it an incorrect solution.

claims.claim: The frozen specialized implementation is faster than generic published engines in this implementation.
claims.qualification: Do not use 38.09% as the causal effect of the new bound. The same-kernel 27.17% is the primary attributable contrast; implementation/container/bookkeeping costs explain additional differences.

claims.claim: The same bound has an implemented single-epoch online J adapter.
claims.formula: J_PAIR = J_R + H_PAIR - H_R before the first handoff; only the completion lower bound of incoming b changes.
claims.qualification: Every old/new customer is charged once. Prefix costs and the fixed other-route cost use the forecast, while future witnesses are static free-flow lower envelopes. No general FIFO assumption is made for COARSE. RAW local J_R, not inherited Pathmax, enters the pair cutoff. This bounds forecast J, not actual SUMO J.

claims.claim: The online connection completed native execution and independent audit.
claims.qualification: Representative replays are weighted by policy frequency; they are not 3 independent native repeats. All 18 customers complete and no recorded collisions/relevant collision warnings occur; neither establishes real-world safety. Online independent mothers are 8, not 64/128/1728. It is one network/epoch with a fixed other route, not rolling fleet dispatch.

claims.claim: Adding PAIR gives no incremental native customer-flow or handoff-wait improvement on this cohort.
claims.qualification: The two methods choose identical plans and identical quantized 0.2s activation ticks. This explains the deterministic physical ties; it does not establish general forecast accuracy or lack of benefit in all environments.

claims.claim: Online extra pruning does not repay its checking cost here.
claims.qualification: At 50ms expanded totals use all64 cases whereas the paired proof-time subset has63. At 200ms both use64. Do not report fewer expansions as less wall time.

claims.claim: The 10ms native rows are predominantly late-initializer fallback execution, not timely solution quality.
claims.qualification: Do not count late plans as within-budget quality or hide them because physical execution later completed. At 50/200ms all192 plans for each main arm are timely and improve the initializer.

claims.claim: The observed 11.50% online J reduction relative to old ROUTE is not an incremental PAIR benefit.
claims.qualification: Ordinary RADIUS, same-engine AWA without PAIR, and ANA attain the same physical outcome. New a/b and truck wait are worse on average than old ROUTE; total J improves through old-customer flow. Do not infer Pareto improvement, reduced truck wait, or unique joint-bound benefit.

claims.claim: The online gate often avoids more expensive evaluation.
claims.qualification: Instrumentation is separate and affects completed work. Do not pool profile time with formal timing, add nested timers twice, or infer service benefit from skip frequency.

claims.claim: Actual Windows worker process peaks were measured, but a causal algorithm RAM reduction was not established.
claims.qualification: Lifetime peaks mostly precede solving and cannot be reset. Ratio-of-sums and median-case-ratio are different metrics. PeakWorkingSetSize includes shared/private resident pages; PeakPagefileUsage is peak process commit, not pagefile writes; current PrivateUsage is not a peak. One process observation per cell gives no repeat-variability estimate. Neither baseline subtraction nor frontier/cache size is algorithm-exclusive RAM. The endpoint excludes full-fleet/SUMO RAM.

must_not_write: The proposed method is the first resource envelope, first quota bound, first lazy heuristic, or a universally novel search algorithm.
We reproduced and beat the complete Hof-Schneider freight ALNS or Wei multi-echelon algorithm.
The 38.09% specialized-versus-generic time difference is caused entirely by the new joint bound.
The 256 scenarios or 3072 calls are independent instances; the 64 online scenarios are64 independent networks.
The entire solver is polynomial because the individual RADIUS threshold is polynomial.
The method uniformly improves early good solutions, every case, every traffic regime, or arbitrary problem sizes.
A one-second run or a first weighted-search solution automatically proves optimality or a factor-two guarantee.
The H2 optimum is an optimum of total customer flow J, a complete delivery tour, truck waiting, or citywide fleet dispatch.
The online bound incorporates measured congestion into every future witness or is proved admissible for actual SUMO cost.
The online study demonstrates positive incremental delivery/wait gains from PAIR; it does not.
The 11.50% gain over old ROUTE is uniquely due to the new joint relation.
Fewer expanded labels establish faster runtime, lower RAM, or better customer service.
Small raw lifetime process-peak differences establish algorithm memory savings.
Traffic/pedestrian exposure counts establish a causal delay reduction; collision-free tested output establishes real-world safety.
The finite correctness gate is an exhaustive proof of all larger inputs or a formal floating-point verification.
Technical repetition counts justify confidence intervals, significance, or acceptance probability without a prespecified valid analysis.
open_gaps: Formula-level literature comparison is bounded by inspected primary material; the complete COR DOI10.1016/j.cor.2026.107577 comparison remains incomplete.
Complete freight ALNS/multi-echelon system reproduction remains missing; baseline labels must disclose published-policy adaptation.
No arbitrary multi-batch incoming stream, alternate a/b pickup order, cross-receiver batch split or citywide joint route optimization is established.
No continuous rolling dispatch, calibrated city traffic, actual-optimal native oracle, incremental service gain or algorithm-exclusive RAM benefit is demonstrated.
Online proof and local H2 theorem require distinct assumptions and objectives; keep them in one method-plus-integration narrative rather than claiming two independent positive contributions.
evidence_use_rules: Use exact candidate direction from Directed_Proof_Pairs.csv. A reverse-row 37.30% baseline increase is not a 37.30% candidate reduction.
State paired denominator beside each time/state ratio and retain the one incomplete-proof case in full quality tables.
Report wall-clock elapsed solve time, including context/setup/greedy/root bound; do not relabel it CPU time.
Treat correctness, optimum attainment, proof, timing, memory and physical service as separate endpoints.
Use final manifests and completed gates; stale code_notes preparation status is historical, not current authority.
No new outcome-based case selection, experiment, or old artifact modification was performed by this review.
